Acid rain refers to any precipitation (rain, snow, fog) that is unusually acidic, meaning it possesses elevated levels of hydrogen ions ($pH < 5.6$). 
- **Causes:** Emissions of sulfur dioxide ($SO_2$) and nitrogen oxides ($NO_x$) from fossil fuel combustion, industrial processes, and vehicular exhausts. These gases react with atmospheric water vapor to form sulfuric acid ($H_2SO_4$) and nitric acid ($HNO_3$).
- **Effects:** Lowers pH of water bodies harming aquatic life, leaches essential soil nutrients, damages vegetation, and corrodes architectural structures and historical monuments.
